response.overview: Humanity is on the brink of extinction. When a mad scientist injects himself with water bear (called Kumamushi in Japanese) DNA and gets a squishy body, humanity soon transforms into Kumamushians, and the world is saved. But 20 years later, a group of boys refuse to become Kumamushian and rise up against the invasion.  A passion-fueled stop-motion animation by 3 Japanese high schoolers from their school's film club.
response.title: The Perfect Body
